eras.full_title: Figure 1: Pre-LLM & Transfer-Learning NLP Ecosystem (2017-06 to 2020-05): Task Complexity Hierarchy & Compute Allocation
eras.subtitle: The Fine-Tuned Encoder Era — Triggered by Transformer (2017-06), ULMFiT (2018-01) & BERT (2018-10)

steps.name: Rule Engines & Cloud NLP APIs
steps.tools: Regex, spaCy v2, scikit-learn, AWS Comprehend, GCP NLP
steps.scope: Single sentence / keyword / sentiment tag
steps.limit: Fails on context, synonyms & multi-sentence logic

steps.name: Static Word Vectors + Task RNNs/CNNs
steps.tools: Word2Vec, GloVe, fastText + Keras/PyTorch BiLSTM-CRF
steps.scope: Single-task document classification & custom NER
steps.limit: One fixed vector per word; loses context past ~100 words

steps.name: Pretrained Encoder Fine-Tuning (BERT)
steps.tools: BERT, RoBERTa, ULMFiT, DistilBERT, HuggingFace, GPT-2
steps.scope: Multi-sentence Q&A, search ranking & domain NLU
steps.limit: 512-token window; requires 1k–10k labeled rows per task

steps.name: From-Scratch Sequence & Deep RL Systems
steps.tools: fairseq, tensor2tensor, BioBERT, OpenAI Five, AlphaStar
steps.scope: Full translation engine, domain pretraining or game RL
steps.limit: Requires multi-GPU/TPU pods (USD 1k–160k+) & PhD team

eras.full_title: Figure 2: Completion Foundation Models & Early Copilot Ecosystem (2020-06 to 2022-10): Complexity & Resource Profile
eras.subtitle: The Few-Shot Completion Era — Triggered by OpenAI GPT-3 API (2020-06, USD 60/1M) & GitHub Copilot Preview (2021-06)

steps.name: Single-Line IDE Autocomplete & Copy Templates
steps.tools: GitHub Copilot (Codex), TabNine, Jasper.ai, Copy.ai
steps.scope: Single line of code (15–50 tokens) or marketing blurb
steps.limit: Blind to multi-file architecture; hallucinates APIs

steps.name: Zero-Shot & Few-Shot Completion Prompting
steps.tools: OpenAI Playground, davinci / text-davinci-002 API
steps.scope: Single-task extraction, summary or draft via 3–5 examples
steps.limit: 2k–4k context ceiling; requires manual stop-token tuning

steps.name: Early Embedding Search & Prompt Chains
steps.tools: FAISS, Pinecone (2021), Weaviate, OpenAI Embeddings
steps.scope: Multi-document semantic lookup + chained API calls
steps.limit: High latency & USD 60/1M token cost; custom glue code

steps.name: Task-Specific Encoder & Open-Model Fine-Tuning
steps.tools: RoBERTa, DeBERTa-v3, T5, GPT-J-6B, HuggingFace Trainer
steps.scope: High-volume enterprise classification & custom domain models
steps.limit: Full-weight GPU training (USD 100–2,500) per task update

eras.full_title: Figure 3: Conversational Web Chat, Custom Vector RAG & Early Agent Ecosystem (2022-11 to 2024-05): Complexity & Cost
eras.subtitle: The ChatGPT & Custom RAG Era — Triggered by ChatGPT (2022-11), gpt-3.5-turbo USD 2/1M Drop, GPT-4 & LLaMA (2023-03)

steps.name: Single-Turn Web Chat & Inline Autocomplete
steps.status_label: L2 Step 2 Sinks to Free Web UI
steps.tools: ChatGPT Free (gpt-3.5-turbo), Bing Chat, GitHub Copilot
steps.scope: Single question, email draft, or single-line code completion
steps.limit: Hallucinates facts; lacks private doc or live tool access

steps.name: Multi-Turn Prompting & System Personas
steps.tools: ChatGPT Plus (GPT-4), Custom GPTs, CoT, JSON Function Calling
steps.scope: Multi-turn code/text analysis, structured JSON extraction
steps.limit: 8k–32k context drift; manual copy-paste between browser & IDE

steps.name: Custom Vector Document Search (RAG)
steps.tools: LangChain, LlamaIndex, Pinecone, ChromaDB, ada-002 + GPT-4
steps.scope: Question answering over 10–1,000 private corporate PDFs/wikis
steps.limit: Naive chunking breaks tables & cross-document synthesis

steps.name: Parameter-Efficient Open-Weight Fine-Tuning
steps.tools: LLaMA-2, Mistral-7B, HuggingFace PEFT, QLoRA, Axolotl, vLLM
steps.scope: Custom domain tone, SQL dialect, or private on-prem model
steps.limit: Teaches form/style rather than new factual knowledge

steps.name: Experimental Autonomous Agent Loops
steps.tools: AutoGPT, BabyAGI, AgentGPT, LangChain ReAct while-loops
steps.scope: Open-ended multi-step web browsing & file goal execution
steps.limit: Cascading hallucinations (~80% fail over 10 steps) & runaway cost

eras.full_title: Figure 4: Multimodal Context, Multi-File IDE Pairing & First Reasoning Models (2024-06 to 2025-01): Complexity & Cost
eras.subtitle: The Sonnet 3.5, Cursor & o1 Era — Triggered by GPT-4o, Claude 3.5 Sonnet + Artifacts (2024-06), 90% KV-Cache & o1 (2024-09)

steps.name: Multimodal Web Chat & Built-In File/Web Search
steps.status_label: L3 Single-PDF RAG Sinks to UI
steps.tools: GPT-4o, Claude 3.5 Sonnet Artifacts/Projects, NotebookLM, Perplexity
steps.scope: Multi-PDF/image Q&A, live web search, interactive UI prototype
steps.limit: Single-turn output without hard math proofs or repo edits

steps.name: Single-Call Reasoning Models (RLVR)
steps.tools: OpenAI o1-preview, o1, o1-mini, DeepSeek-R1 (Jan 2025), QwQ
steps.scope: PhD math/physics derivation, competitive code & logic proofs
steps.limit: Isolated text box; lacks live multi-file IDE or bash execution

steps.name: Multi-File IDE Pairing & Hybrid Enterprise RAG
steps.tools: Cursor Composer, Windsurf, Copilot Edits, Cohere Rerank 3 + KV-Cache
steps.scope: Coordinated 3–10 file code edits or reranked corporate search
steps.limit: Human must review diffs & manually fix failing terminal tests

steps.name: Stateful Graph Workflows & Multi-Agent Pipelines
steps.tools: LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, LlamaIndex Workflows, Prompt Routing
steps.scope: Deterministic branching customer-support, research & ETL pipelines
steps.limit: Rigid pre-coded graph edges; breaks on unexpected OS/repo states

steps.name: Cloud Sandbox & Screen Agents + Post-Training
steps.tools: Cognition Devin, Anthropic Computer Use, SWE-agent, Llama-3.1 DPO
steps.scope: Autonomous cloud VM ticket attempts, GUI clicking & distillation
steps.limit: Slow GUI latency, USD 500/mo cost & ~15–25% unassisted PR pass

eras.full_title: Figure 5: Terminal CLI Harnesses, Deep Research, MCP & Parallel Agent Fleets (2025-02 to 2026-10): Complexity & Cost
eras.subtitle: The Agentic Harness & Fleet Era — Triggered by Deep Research & Claude Code (2025-02), MCP Standard (2025-03) & o3/Claude 4

steps.name: Auto-Routed Hybrid Chat & Instant Tab Edit
steps.tools: GPT-5/4o, Claude 4/4.5 Sonnet, Gemini 2.5 Flash, Cursor Tab
steps.scope: Everyday chat, voice/vision, auto-thinking slider & tab edits
steps.limit: Single-response window; stops short of 20-min research or repo loops

steps.name: Autonomous Deep Research & Synthesis
steps.tools: OpenAI Deep Research, Gemini/Perplexity Deep Research, o3-pro
steps.scope: 10–30 min autonomous browsing & synthesis across 50–150 sources
steps.limit: Read-only web/file synthesis; stops short of repo/DB mutation

steps.name: Standardized MCP Workflows & Scoped IDE Agents
steps.tools: Model Context Protocol (MCP) Servers + Cursor/Windsurf Agent Mode
steps.scope: Multi-tool business workflows (GitHub/Slack/DB) & scoped IDE features
steps.limit: Interactive single-thread IDE loop; waits on human approvals

steps.name: Autonomous Terminal CLI & Cloud Repo Agents
steps.tools: Claude Code CLI, OpenAI Codex CLI/Cloud, Cline, Devin 2.0
steps.scope: Full-repo refactors, running bash/linters/tests & self-fixing PRs
steps.limit: Serial single-agent execution; context fills on massive monorepos

steps.name: Parallel Agent Fleets & Custom RLVR Flywheels
steps.tools: Parallel Claude Code/Codex Git Worktrees, verifiers RLVR, TRL GRPO
steps.scope: Orchestrating 3–10 parallel repo agents & custom RLVR post-training
steps.limit: Human verification bandwidth & merge-conflict review bottleneck
